pr_title: LE Audio split endpoint implementation into role implementations
pr_body:
Instead of having a large common endpoint.c implementation, the implementation is now split into the different roles: unicast client, unicast server, broadcast source and broadcast sink.

The reason for this is that while some of the functionality is common, most of the function had specific behavior for each role, and required a lot of `if role == <role>` checks, as well as being mostly unicast client related.

A lot of code has simply been moved and slightly cleaned up. It was not really possible to just move the code without changing while ensuring that the commits could build. It may thus be difficult to properly review this, and I apologize in advance. 

fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/41589

issue_context.title: LE Audio: Split unicast client and unicast server functionality
issue_context.body:
Currently the unicast client and the unicast server implementations are implemented across multiple files and sometimes are very high coupled.

This makes it hard to find the code used for either roles, and makes maintenance harder.

The current structure we have for unicast is

- chan.c - Used mainly for the unicast client, and implements the public API functions
- bap.c - Used mainly for the unicast client and implements internal functions (rename to unicast_client)
- endpoint.c - Used for both server and client (and broadcast) and implements both ISO handling as well as some ASE functionality.
- ascs.c - Used mainly (exclusively?) for the server
- capabilities.c - Used mainly for the sever, but is also used by the client
- pacs.c - Used mainly for the server, but should also be used by the scan delegator role.

Since a device is typically only a client or a server, then it makes sense to split the functionality into files that are purely for the client or the server, with the exception of common functionality, e.g. the configurations of streams can be done on either side.
